== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Halfsilver is a rare, glittering metal that resembles ordinary silver embedded with bright, star-like mineral veins. While it is more brittle than standard silver, its primary characteristic is its ability to disrupt and [[shear]] through [[madra]]. This disruptive property makes it highly valuable for specialized uses, such as the creation of [[Soulsmith tools]] and certain weaponry. Because of its utility in interfering with [[madra]], it is frequently incorporated into high-security items like prison cell doors, [[chains]], and [[iron-and-crystal manacles|manacles]] to prevent practitioners from using their abilities to escape. It is also used in various implements, including daggers, awls, sabers, spearheads, tongs, and even badges of rank. Although it is a precious material that can serve as significant wealth or a sect's treasure, its presence can be problematic for users, as it interferes with the orderly control of [[madra]] if held against the skin or channeled through it.}}
